tools.name: Link Checker
tools.description: Automatically shows the real address of every link and its domain owner, no need to hold the link.

tools.name: WHOIS Lookup
tools.description: Shows when a domain was registered. Scam domains are usually only a few days old.

tools.name: Sandbox
tools.description: Runs a file in an isolated space and reports what it does, without putting office computers at risk.

tools.name: Log Filter
tools.description: Sums up logins by IP address: how many failed, how many succeeded, and from where.
